title: DeWolfe--Gubser--Rosen finite-density EMD classical benchmark
summary: An owner-approved reduced Phase 5B contract for representative neutral and charged DeWolfe--Gubser--Rosen EMD backgrounds, a direct reproduction of the reported critical-coordinate neighborhood, N=80/120/150 spectral refinement at the located state, and an independent simultaneous-Maxwell formulation. The absolute density ordinate and global topology of source Figure 5 are explicitly outside this classical-example benchmark and remain available only as a separately reviewed extension.

conventions.name: bulk theory and units
conventions.value: Five bulk dimensions, mostly-plus signature, L = 1 and kappa_5^2 = 1 before source rescalings
conventions.rationale: Fixes the EMD action and the dimensionless black-hole thermodynamics.

conventions.name: ensemble
conventions.value: Grand canonical at each selected boundary chemical potential
conventions.rationale: The boundary value of the regular electric potential is the chemical potential.

conventions.name: canonical density
conventions.value: rho_canonical_BH = q/2 with q = -f_EMD exp(A) Phi' > 0 in the inward conformal coordinate
conventions.rationale: This follows from the source Gauss law and UV holographic dictionary.

conventions.name: Figure 5 axes
conventions.value: mu_BH is the horizontal abscissa and rho_source_figure5 is the digitized vertical ordinate
conventions.rationale: No verified public map identifies the artwork ordinate with rho_canonical_BH, so absolute ordinate agreement cannot enter acceptance.

parameters.name: gauge kinetic function
parameters.description: The source Maxwell coupling normalized by f_EMD(0) = 1.

parameters.name: critical initial coordinate
parameters.description: Frozen initial coordinate for the direct local critical locator.

parameters.name: critical derivative steps
parameters.description: Five-point constant-temperature derivative steps and an unused-in-fit validation step.

parameters.name: selected controls
parameters.description: Neutral, representative charged, and high-charge background controls.

parameters.name: source scales
parameters.description: Published calibration values used only to report the critical coordinates.

equations.description: Fully backreacted charged conformal-gauge background equations after analytic Maxwell-flux reduction.
equations.source_ref: Source Eqs. (27)-(29), transformed to inward conformal gauge.

equations.description: Orientation-fixed conserved Maxwell flux used by the primary formulation.
equations.source_ref: Source Eqs. (28), (33), and (38), transformed to inward conformal gauge.

equations.expression: Phi=mu-u^(2/nu)e; K=2e+nu u e_u; nu u K_u+[alpha+1+(partial_phi ln f) beta]K=0
equations.description: UV-factorized Maxwell equation collocated simultaneously with geometry and scalar fields as an independent route.
equations.source_ref: Source Maxwell equation transformed to the approved coordinates.

equations.description: Canonical physical density in the frozen source normalization.
equations.source_ref: Source Eqs. (38), (42), and (45), with L = kappa_5 = 1.

equations.description: Local critical conditions evaluated with five-point constant-temperature stencils.
equations.source_ref: Thermodynamic critical-point condition applied to the source EMD family.

observables.name: temperature
observables.extraction: Use the exact horizon derivative of h and the published lambda_T scale.

observables.name: chemical potential
observables.extraction: Integrate q exp(-A)/f_EMD from boundary to horizon and apply lambda_mu only for source-coordinate reporting.

observables.name: entropy density
observables.extraction: Evaluate the horizon-area density in the frozen L = kappa_5 = 1 normalization.

observables.name: canonical charge density
observables.extraction: Evaluate q/2 from the conserved Maxwell flux.

observables.name: source Figure 5 ordinate
observables.extraction: Retain only in approved digitized reference records; no absolute comparison to rho_canonical_BH is made.

acceptance_criteria: All three fixed controls and all three located-state resolutions pass nonlinear, oversampled equation, Einstein constraint, boundary, target, Gauss-flux, and Noether-charge gates.
The simultaneous explicit-Maxwell formulation agrees with the flux-reduced formulation for the reported thermodynamic observables within 5e-6.
The direct critical candidate agrees with (T_c,mu_c)=(143,783) MeV within (5,10) MeV and with (phi_H,eta)=(4.84,0.40) within (0.20,0.04).
Normalized local critical diagnostics and step-to-step coordinate changes do not exceed 2e-3.
The fixed critical state refines through N=80,120,150 with the final scaled change at most 2e-3 and no worsening above the 1e-8 ordering floor.
Duplicate complete verifier runs agree within 1e-10.
Figure 5 anchor records remain provenance-only and the unresolved absolute density ordinate cannot affect acceptance.

tests.expected: All seven bounded scientific and determinism gates pass without asserting global topology or absolute Figure 5 density agreement.
Equations, selected controls, two formulations, direct critical coordinates, refinement, strict JSON, and artifact safeguards pass.
Three approved Figure 5 records preserve mu_BH as abscissa, rho_source_figure5 as ordinate, and the blocked absolute-comparison state.
The optional topology campaign preserves its primary-temperature overlap hard stop and cannot affect reduced-core acceptance.

claims.statement: The DGR source action and UV dictionary define the canonical density as rho_canonical_BH = q/2 in the source-normalized L = kappa_5 = 1 convention.
claims.evidence: DGR arXiv:1012.1864v2 Eqs. (38), (42), and (45), with same-author restatements in arXiv:1108.2029 and arXiv:1304.7794.

claims.statement: The reduced HoloForge verifier reproduces representative finite-density DGR EMD backgrounds and the reported critical-coordinate neighborhood, with spectral refinement and an independent simultaneous-Maxwell formulation.
claims.evidence: Owner-approved 2026-08-23 verification record: all seven reduced-core gates pass; (T_c,mu_c)=(142.973974 MeV,781.693762 MeV); N=120 to 150 maximum scaled change 2.1982e-13; maximum cross-route observable difference 9.9333e-10.

limitations: This is a phenomenological bottom-up model; no top-down embedding or empirical validation of QCD is claimed.
Owner approval applies only to the reduced selected-state and critical-coordinate contract; it does not approve the optional topology extension.
The source provides no verified public map from rho_source_figure5 to rho_canonical_BH; absolute Figure 5 ordinate agreement is blocked.
The verifier reproduces a local critical-coordinate neighborhood, not a global phase diagram, an equal-free-energy coexistence line, or critical exponents.
The selected-state contract is not evidence that all finite-density branches have been found or classified.
The primary reconstructed-Phi Maxwell residual uses the owner-approved 1e-6 conditioning ceiling; the independent explicit Gauss-flux gate remains 1e-7.
The historical C3h topology extension remains stopped by its frozen primary-temperature overlap gate and is not repaired or waived by this re-scope.
The optional topology campaign, DOP853 route, Figure 5 absolute density comparison, and all Phase 5C scaling work require separate owner authorization.
